title: model-specific runtime optimizations: Llama / Mistral / Qwen quirks + GQA/MQA tuning
author: Evan Park
description: Motivation: several production workloads show model-specific pathological patterns that hurt throughput and single-token latency. This PR applies targeted runtime changes to improve kernels, scheduling and KV cache handling for Llama, Mistral and Qwen-family models, and ships GQA/MQA tuning knobs. Summary of changes: kernel selector heuristics updated to consider per-layer key/value shapes and rotary embedding patterns (important for Llama and some Mistral forks); attention kernel variants for Qwen where per-head length and key grouping favored grouped-GEMM; MQA (multi-query attention) alignment fixes and fast-path kernels for GQA-like grouped quantized attention; KV cache prefetch + compact layout support to reduce page faults for long context reuse; continuous batching scheduler improvements to avoid batching single-token tail requests with large prefixes (reduces p95 latency); dynamic micro-batch sizing based on sequence-length histogram to improve utilization without raising 99th-percentile latency; compatibility shims for model loaders to expose architecture quirks into runtime (e.g., rotary base and ALiBi masks). Benchmarks: internal perf lab (perf-canary) synthetic replay with mixed short chat (average 24 tokens) and long-context LLM evals shows throughput +18-32% on Mistral and Qwen variants depending on batch mix, and single-token p95 latency improvement 12-28% on MQA/GQA-heavy traffic. Implementation details: - runtime/kernel_selector.cpp: added heuristics to prefer grouped-GEMM kernels for Qwen-like attention shapes and to prefer MQA fast-path for models flagged as multi-query. - runtime/scheduler.cpp: continuous batching scheduler refactored to expose per-model batching policy, micro-batch autosizer uses recent sequence length histogram (.last_token_lengths window) to pick batch_size and target latency budget. - runtime/kv_cache.cpp: introduced compact-kv layout and async prefetch for repeated-token prefixes; added metrics for cache-hit vs prefetch-fallback. - models/qwen_adapter.cpp and models/mistral_compat.cpp: adapters to detect and surface model quirks (rotary base, head-grouping, kv-layout) to the runtime; loader tests updated. - quant/gqa_tuner.cc: heuristics for grouped quantization aware (GQA) layout selection and threshold tuning for 4-bit/8-bit MQA profiles. - tests/perf/model_specific/{qwen_mqa_replay, mistral_long_context}.py and docs/notes/perf-gqa-mqa.md: benchmark harness and notes. Backwards compatibility: runtime falls back to previous kernels when model flags absent. Toggle flags: runtime_config.experimental.model_quick_flags allow staged rollout. Rollout plan: staged on dedicated clusters first (5% traffic) then host-wide after monitoring. Related work: ENG-7890 (model-specific kernel selector), ENG-8021 (GQA/MQA tuning), SUP-4123 (customer report of Qwen p99 regressions). Checklist: [x] unit tests for selector paths [x] perf regression tests [x] end-to-end smoke on dedicated cluster [x] docs/notes updated [x] monitoring dashboards added. Links: internal linear=ENG-7890, benchmark reports in perf-canary dashboard.

merge_commit_message:
model-specific runtime optimizations: llama/mistral/qwen + GQA/MQA tuning

Improvements to kernel selection, scheduler, KV cache and quant tuning. Rollout gated behind runtime flags.
release_notes: Performance: model-specific kernel selection and scheduler improvements yield up to 32% throughput improvements on Mistral/Qwen workloads and 12-28% p95 latency reduction for MQA/GQA traffic. Ops: new runtime flag runtime_config.experimental.model_quick_flags to gate targeted optimizations for staged rollout. Testing: added perf replay scripts and CI perf check.
notes_for_release: Staged rollout: enable on Dedicated (5% traffic) -> monitor kv_cache.hit_ratio and p95 latency dashboards -> increase to 25% then 100% if stable. If unexpected regressions set runtime_config.experimental.model_quick_flags=false to disable.
